description:
Vintage Calligraphy & Writing Collectible Set
Mixed Media Desk Set with Display Box
Wood, Glass, Metal, and Paper, 11 x 8 x 3 Inches
This comprehensive vintage writing and philatelic collection is housed in a decorative black wooden chest with a patterned interior lid. The set features classical tools for traditional correspondence, including both hand-blown glass and carved wooden dip pens, alongside an ornamental magnifying glass and a curated selection of mid-20th-century American postage stamps. Such sets were characteristic elements of personal stationery desks, appealing to calligraphy practitioners and historical ephemera collectors.
Hand-blown twisted glass dip pen and turned wooden pen handle with internal metal nib holder
11 assorted metal pen nibs in various sizes for calligraphy and fine writing
Vintage-style magnifying glass featuring an ornate, relief-patterned metal handle
6 vintage US postage stamps including 1949 Puerto Rico Inauguration (3c) and Noah Webster (4c) issues
Hinged black wooden box with dedicated storage compartments and a decorative patterned underside lid
Condition:
The wooden box shows light exterior shelf wear and surface dust accumulation. The glass pen is intact with no visible chips to the spiral writing tip; includes a small protective sleeve. The wooden pen handle shows significant surface patina, staining, and finish wear consistent with age. Metal nibs show varying degrees of surface oxidation. Stamps are in used/mixed condition; one Noah Webster stamp has a visible tear and several show adhesive residue or hinging marks. Magnifying glass lens is clear with minor tarnishing to the metal frame.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

description:
CONDITION: Some broken or missing items. Surface scratches and wear. Pre-Owned; Recommend Cleaning Before Use
May have surface scratches, patina, natural imperfections, scuffs and/or chips that may not be easily detected.
Item(s) are intended to be wearable, however some pieces may show signs of heavy use or damage. Photos shown on this listing are of the actual items being sold and should be viewed carefully. Condition and value of individual pieces will vary.
Metals and stones are not tested for material makeup unless otherwise noted.
Watches have not been professionally tested or serviced and we do not offer any guarantee on functionality or life of watches.
Unless otherwise stated in the listing, items do not come with official certificates and will not include documentation.
PRECIOUS METALS and GEMSTONE TESTING:
Where testing is indicated in the listing, gems are tested with a Presidium gem tester and confirmed by our
Certified Gemologist
; white stones such as diamonds are also tested with a GemOro Ultra 3+ tester. Please note this tester cannot differentiate between manufactured and natural stones. All precious metals including gold, silver, platinum and palladium are tested with acid testing.
NO RETURNS or REFUNDS:
Pieces are sold AS-IS and are NOT eligible for return or refund for any reason.
You are bidding with this in mind.
NON-PAYMENT:
Items not paid for by the deadline date will be relisted the next business day.
PICKUP ITEMS:
Local shoppers can avoid shipping costs by picking up in person at our warehouse within 2 weeks of purchase. Please submit a ticket promptly after payment with your preferred pickup day/time. We will respond with confirmation within 24-48 hours.
NOTE:
Items purchased for pickup MUST be picked up in our facility within 2 weeks of purchase date. Items not picked up by the deadline will be considered abandoned and will be re-donated back to Goodwill without refund.
COMBINING ORDERS:
If you wish to combine items, please do so before processing your items for payment. Please note, there are limits to the size and weight of items we can safely combine for shipping purposes and therefor we cannot always accommodate those requests.
DISCLAIMER:
All auctions are previously owned items in used condition that have been donated to Goodwill and sold to support our outreach services in the community. Items are sold as they are received. Items are not cleaned or repaired prior to being sold. Our staff are not experts in any field and cannot identify every detail or verify functionality of items. Details are provided to the best of our ability and any measurements are approximate. Please read and understand the description, as well as reviewing photos carefully, before placing your bid.

1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

description: This lot includes five natural mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors or educational use. Specimens consist of a rough beige quartz or calcite piece, a brown petrified wood sample with visible grain, a dark greenish-gray porous volcanic rock chunk, a smaller layered petrified wood fragment, and a clear quartz mineral with orange and green inclusions. All pieces are unpolished, show natural wear, and vary in size from small fragments to palm-sized. No manufacturer markings are present.
